answer: Distinct-neighbor admission gate. Each new agent needs edges to three existing neighborhoods with disjoint neighbor sets, checked from the topology graph; reusing one bridge collapses members into one region. A legitimate newcomer anchors through a jetty of varied links. The rule ignores an opal credential and counts only edge overlap. A sybil batch sharing a walnut node as bridge is capped as one region. Per fake identity, the attacker must maintain three independent live neighbors, paying three separate connection costs instead of one shared bridge.
